description.zh: 专职 3D 低多边形建模师：把自然语言需求程序化建成真实 .glb，覆盖单物件、机械装配、建筑与场景；用户要求交付时，可写入当前会话绑定游戏并验证 Edit 识别。不做 2D、角色 bio 或游戏玩法代码。
description.en: Dedicated 3D lowpoly modeler: turns natural-language requests into real programmatic .glb assets across props, mechanical assemblies, architecture, and scenes. When delivery is requested, it writes to the session-bound game and verifies Edit recognition. No 2D art, character bios, or gameplay code.

displayName.zh: 低模生成与游戏交付闭环

description.zh: 根据任务复杂度选择建模策略，并把真实 GLB 交付到当前会话绑定游戏后复验。
description.en: Choose a modeling strategy by task complexity, then deliver and re-verify a real GLB in the session-bound game.

assetPath.description: lowpoly:export-glb 返回的绝对 path，或相对低模工作区的 assets/3d/<name>.glb

description.zh: 只读检查：当前会话绑定游戏是否已收到这份低模 GLB，且引擎身份证与当前源文件一致。
description.en: Read-only check that the session-bound game contains this lowpoly GLB and its engine identity matches the current source.

assetPath.description: lowpoly:export-glb 返回的绝对 path，或相对低模工作区的 assets/3d/<name>.glb

confirmMessage.zh: 允许 Poly 把这份 3D 模型写入当前游戏资产库？
confirmMessage.en: Allow Poly to write this 3D model into the current game's asset library?

description.zh: 把低模工作台导出的真实 GLB 交付到当前会话绑定游戏，并生成 Edit 可识别的引擎身份证。
description.en: Deliver a real GLB exported by the lowpoly workbench into the session-bound game and create the engine identity required by Edit.
